summary: Sequential startup syncs in a stable folder order, an About entry in the tray, and tray menu icons that stay readable on dark themes.
changelog: Startup no longer hops between folders in a random order: the boot backlog runs one folder at a time in the configured order (issue #154).
The tray menu gains an About entry, last in the menu, showing the same dialog as the window (issue #155).
Tray menu icons use a theme-neutral gray so they read on dark themes, and Log/About no longer share or lose their glyphs (issue #157).
The project gains AppStream metainfo, community files and issue templates (issue #156).
New versioning scheme: numbering restarts at 0.1.4 and grows +0.0.2 per release.
